.rogue-scrap-grid {

padding: 14px;

box-sizing: border-box;
transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.rogue-scrap-card:hover {
transform: translateY(-2px);
box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}
.rogue-scrap-card.rarity-RARE { border-left-color: #38d0d4; }
.rogue-scrap-card.rarity-SUPER_RARE { border-left-color: #e8b341; }
.rogue-scrap-head {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 10px;
border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 242, 236, 0.1);
padding-bottom: 6px;
}
.rogue-scrap-name {
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 700;
flex: 1;
color: #9aa7a5;
}
.rogue-scrap-card.rarity-RARE .rogue-scrap-name { color: #38d0d4; }
.rogue-scrap-card.rarity-SUPER_RARE .rogue-scrap-name { color: #e8b341; }
.rogue-scrap-usage {
line-height: 1.5;
font-size: 13.5px;
}
.rogue-scrap-desc {
opacity: .5;
font-style: italic;
font-size: 12px;
line-height: 1.4;
border-left: 2px solid rgba(244, 242, 236, 0.2);
padding-left: 6px;
margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.rogue-scrap-foot {
margin-top: auto;
display: flex;
align-items: flex-end; /* 让价格和范围底部对齐 */
justify-content: space-between;
padding-top: 8px;
border-top: 1px dashed rgba(244, 242, 236, 0.1);
font-size: 13px;
}
.rogue-scrap-price-box {
padding-bottom: 4px; /* 让文字与右侧图形在视觉上更平衡 */
}
.rogue-scrap-price {
color: #e8b341;
font-weight: bold;
}
.rogue-scrap-range-container {
width: 65px; /* 适当放宽容器，留出容错空间 */
height: 65px;/* 固定高度 */
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); /* 略微深色的背景衬托范围格子 */
border: 1px solid rgba(244, 242, 236, 0.1);
border-radius: 4px;
overflow: hidden;/* 必须：隐藏溢出部分 */
position: relative;
}
.rogue-scrap-range-container > div {
transform: scale(0.45); /* 重点：因为是7x7的巨型div矩阵，强力缩小至 45% */
transform-origin: center center;
position: absolute;
width: max-content !important; /* 强制其内部宽度由子节点撑开，不换行 */
white-space: nowrap;
}
